editorial.description_en: The green of serpentinite, which is a rock rather than a plant and looks it — flatter and cooler than anything growing.
editorial.description_ja: 蛇紋岩のような、つめたく暗い緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.620, C 0.056, h 160.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 蛇 (ja, snake) + 紋 (mon, pattern), after the rock 蛇紋岩. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Serpentine" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 蛇紋. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — sugi-kage at ΔE00 4.8, natsu-kage at ΔE00 7.3, numa-omote at ΔE00 8.3. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
